character.motivation: Her maps erased the flooded homes by using the council's legend. Wants the families to choose what goes back in.
character.voice: Specific about distances and names, skeptical of tidy maps.
character.backstory: Indigo drew the official map after the flood using a council legend that omitted the damaged homes. Her mother had walked that road every day, and Orin still knows where the doors stood.
character.quest_hook: Take the map to former residents and record the names they want restored, including any they want kept off public copies.

dialogue.introduction: The old map calls this an empty valley. My mother was born in one of those empty places.
dialogue.friendship: I drew the road that goes nowhere. My mother walked it every morning before the flood.
dialogue.supper: People kept pointing out houses on the map I brought. I left the pencil there so they could draw them in.
dialogue.hearing: I'm putting the old houses back on the map. I'll use the names the families give me.
dialogue.favorite_gift: Good. I needed something dry to wrap the measuring rods in.
dialogue.disliked_gift: The survey bag smells like wet paper already. Please keep the bread.

routine.home_context: Picked the far end of the terrace so she could walk the ridge and sight back down the valley.
